# Emmy-Award Winning Television Host Montel Williams to Join Next ‘Let’s Huddle’ Webinar


October 22, 2026 4:15pm EDT


### Patient advocacy initiative expands its reach with a nationally recognized voice on health, resilience and informed treatment decisions


TORONTO, Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Profound Medical Corp. (NASDAQ:PROF; TSX:PRN) (“Profound” or the “Company”) today announced that Emmy Award-winning television host, health advocate and decorated U.S. Navy veteran, Montel Williams, will join the next[Let’s Huddle](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=V7i1kpZbujmh5rxXOTSDUqDKyfO4b2MZiafHZ1-mg-IhA2OaRqKKVwZ59hwuO85pGwMOECOpT3FFFMnW1v6k8A==) webinar for a discussion with its host, Leonard Wheeler, on November 5, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. ET.


Mr. Williams will share his personal perspectives on health advocacy, resilience, informed healthcare decisions and the importance of protecting quality of life. His participation brings a prominent public voice to *Let’s Huddle* , a global patient community dedicated to helping men and their families navigate the prostate care journey through education, connection and support.


"When we created *Let's Huddle* , our goal was to build a community where men and their families could have meaningful conversations, ask difficult questions, share experiences and feel supported as they navigate important healthcare decisions," said Tom Tamberrino, Chief Commercial Officer of Profound Medical. "Montel's experience as a respected broadcaster, veteran and passionate health advocate makes him a powerful addition to this conversation. His participation reinforces our commitment to putting patients first and helping men feel informed, empowered and supported throughout their prostate care journey."


Mr. Williams has built a distinguished career spanning military service, television and health advocacy. After graduating from the United States Naval Academy in 1980, he served in the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps, retiring in 1996 with the rank of lieutenant commander. His military honors include two Meritorious Service Medals and two Navy Commendation Medals.


Following his military career, Mr. Williams hosted *The Montel Williams Show* for 17 years, appearing in more than 4,300 episodes and earning a Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Talk Show Host in 1996. After being diagnosed with multiple sclerosis in 1999, he established the Montel Williams MS Foundation to support research and raise public awareness. He continues to advocate for health and wellness, and hosts the podcast *Let's Be Blunt with Montel* and Lifetime's *Military Makeover with Montel* .


**Advancing patient awareness and access to innovative prostate care**


For Profound, *Let's Huddle* is an important extension of its commitment to patient education and engagement, complementing its work to advance innovative approaches to prostate treatment.


"Montel's story is a powerful reminder that health challenges can have a lasting impact on quality of life, long after military service or other major life milestones," said Arun Menawat, Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of Profound Medical. "Men facing prostate disease deserve access to clear information, meaningful support and treatment options that take their quality of life into account. The TULSA Procedure™ offers an incision-free, MRI-guided approach to prostate tissue ablation, designed to provide precise, personalized treatment. We believe initiatives like *Let's Huddle* play an important role in helping patients become informed participants in their care."


Profound is also proud to support expanded access to innovative prostate care for veterans. To that end, the Company recently installed the first TULSA-PRO® system at a U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs facility to offer veterans access to the TULSA Procedure™, an important milestone in broadening access to this treatment approach.

**Date:** November 5, 2026


**Time:** 3:00 p.m. ET


**Location:** Online at[www.letshuddle.org](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=PRfKLSuJ0l-bUp5WXbDdIN_RY4jGvxT9M3lXspZWM0wah9-GFNYqUATt9Yeyq873MG3YZ_L50-iYGaoRYrumYyxemOS3I371ZzjtM30Tbyw=)

An archived recording will be made available on the *Let's Huddle* website as soon as practicable following the live event.


**About** ***Let's Huddle***


Led by Leonard Wheeler, Profound Medical's Global Patient Ambassador, former professional football player with an eight-year NFL career, Co-Executive Director for NFL Legends, prostate cancer survivor, and men's health advocate, *Let's Huddle* is a global patient community designed to empower men and their families with education, connection and support throughout the prostate care journey.


The initiative reflects Profound's belief that advancing prostate care extends beyond developing innovative technology. By fostering education, peer connection and informed dialogue, *Let's Huddle* helps men, allies, and families better understand their options, engage in treatment discussions and navigate the decisions that can shape their quality of life.


**About Profound Medical Corp.**


Profound is a commercial-stage medical device company and an innovator in interventional MRI (iMRI) procedures. The company’s flagship platform,[TULSA-PRO](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=j8kRessQ735q_OfASKtl6kwqvzqX1zzgonXxg3p5HXM9kQ6Xc7akHnupAFAlLTpa0_-pJ3jVpL1WAehPrjdKmZ70D2a1cXXuc3J1PB1PeRzRR8asjBviD8J8zzEsPUE-9Q32rgRabJKTJ78Ex8Rehg-S1wHdeyUNOMxwWC7xHG7HlhIyCNc5pCzp1lEJGuSaeH_4v7q5DNcwOoBeIvNCBZ8n399ZA1KJR76UGo_Qhp2uGP_Jv5Spj7jcFEDHPJTc)[®](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=PK86maquvhyY3_GhSSH4BbZqw5bQMwhuP89CxCO3jRJX7GwOLsfwXFz2oFhHmpxfEMZl7PlCHgNMzchHtVhbN0_hSIZe1A9hSV3kAxwFiixoV5oJ3Mc-d6gJ6RVdREga8hSaDgHC-ZzLqEOlem9we4V6GW-cihkoN7DgXF4CutodZexMWFenODl3U6ZNjbTwdJ9MAqcVkWIZF4ofA-QpGqja0ySzaTpPEroLIcAJmXVwbE3B5ny7EbP9jBJ2dGtQ) , enables MRI-guided, incision-free prostate ablation. Physicians use the[TULSA Procedure™](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=j8kRessQ735q_OfASKtl6itWhidMw4jJeN_p5x31r43wHVZXGGNxG3oixAJOb-V1Kv_Vz-n426bA3wKHaXpJbdiz_bWt4IzBH9GyUJ3sO-sblH32DDwdoXTO2KHWXqb4S0uxFTD6wfmmajSSqJvbN3yoWfgS6XMYtPlK4JggdySXXMzwVFeUkt7t2lc1aGDcbS8imJhuDQxpc9aWQTNTum0B8QrbmAwHh0IM-hiuWAdr0-9j1ZzoM_owf2OJa3zvN1YUmub9-QNoN8UDR0ZDuZWxBUGh_6d8ksRoutkPmGV4hvikx0tlCwIXYDVNGRJ6JV7iR52URdryO2XLDeFYUQ==) to see, ablate, and confirm therapy in real time, supporting personalized treatment strategies across the continuum of prostate care—from whole-gland to subtotal, hemi, multifocal, and focal treatment. This approach enables individualized care using prostate tissue ablation, while minimizing the potential of the side effects that are typically associated with surgery or radiation, such as urinary incontinence and/or erectile dysfunction.


Profound also commercializes[Sonalleve](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=sW98hG_uOE92qCLBj7ihy8jWiuxxT79Gh1L9necO4D-4tNuq9USoXcVecV2ogb-NGSXZjC5rNGAaksQIuS6S4ttU06QB6jhjOK2-ci-9fVJPgmLseIQ1dX23QS2h7N3WKsVuCmSsVPU9jQwxkjorgfLfgF1VR8Y73MwzGO-pfnUTpWnZbDJquL-0-lCTpaSSRJ3_ta6MXOBsOHdywMQHUOoQcksro9wq1Kj4RQAp0pBCwcdpawh60bca_Gvw2olo)[®](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=fEO4AUvf4Tqkb4M-NROrEhTN89btVjhrjMIH2H1ICCP5ZmyNLW_HCi7NommJWsJe69c66_uz7BhSWOpQmQvX10sww5iT1Y40ZYD-pdu4RUnjo64TXOnuPcI2O1NofF7EgMyNy7k84lhgd3Bgbah7TtE4hDP5QKjCtuidqQyLG1j6xtXC_7wqlrHG64NwuphPNKqwigo6lwEfpNdy-B7wxJX0bsSmSyYXXuTuA3Av-ik1fe4i3WRSDqkAmkej76oY) , an MRI-guided therapy that provides a non-surgical treatment option for pain palliation of bone metastases, desmoid tumors, and osteoid osteoma, as well as for common gynecologic conditions including uterine fibroids and adenomyosis. Sonalleve delivers targeted therapy with no incisions, no blood loss during the procedure, no overnight hospital stay, and faster recovery — and, in gynecologic applications, enables uterine-sparing treatment that may help preserve fertility. Profound is also exploring additional clinical applications for Sonalleve, including non-invasive ablation of abdominal cancers and hyperthermia-based cancer therapies.


Profound Medical’s technologies are approved across major global markets. TULSA-PRO is cleared by the FDA in the United States for transurethral ultrasound ablation (TULSA) of prostate tissue. In addition, TULSA-PRO is cleared for use in various jurisdictions including Europe, Canada, Saudi Arabia, India, Australia/New Zealand, and the UAE. Sonalleve is approved by the FDA as HDE in the United States for the treatment of osteoid osteomas in the extremities. Sonalleve is also cleared or approved in the Europe, Canada, China, and Saudi Arabia.


Through real-time MRI guidance and data-driven innovation, Profound is advancing the future of MRI-guided therapy — expanding access to precise, personalized, and incision-free treatment options worldwide.
